body.title: refactor(ai): replace print statements with structured logging
body.body: ## 🚀 OSCG'26 Contributor Notice **NexumDB participates in the Open Source Contributor Games 2026!** High-quality PRs earn you points, recognition, and networking opportunities. Please follow our [contribution guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for maximum impact and ensure your submission meets OSCG quality standards. ## Summary Replaced all user facing print statements with logging in the files nexum_ai/translator.py and nexum_ai/model_manager.py. Closes #142 ### What Changed? -Added module-level logger using logging.getLogger(__name__) -Replaced print statements with appropriate logger levels (info, warning, error, exception) - Kept warning/error semantics equivalent ### Why?
